{"type":"story-content","detail":"docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md currently matches the specification provided in the prompt (same acceptance criteria and REQ-MAINT-* requirements)."}, {"type":"implementation","detail":"Core maintenance API implemented in src/maintenance:

- src/maintenance/detect.ts implements detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[].
 - Resolves workspaceRoot from process.cwd() and codebasePath; if missing or not a directory, returns [] (safe no-op) [REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE].
 - Uses getAllFiles(workspaceRoot) to iterate files and a regex /@story\s+([^\s]+)/g to find @story annotations.
 - For each story path, calls isUnsafeStoryPath to skip traversal/absolute/invalid-extension paths before any fs checks [REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE].
 - Resolves project and workspace candidates and enforces project boundary via enforceProjectBoundary, with try/catch falling back to out-of-project on errors [REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE].
 - anyInProjectCandidateExists only calls fs.existsSync on in-project candidates; if none exist, original storyPath is added to a Set of stale references [REQ-MAINT-DETECT].
- src/maintenance/update.ts implements updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number.
 - Returns 0 if codebasePath does not exist or is not a directory (safe) [REQ-MAINT-UPDATE].
 - Escapes oldPath and builds regex `(@story\s*)${escapedOldPath}` so only the path part is replaced, preserving @story prefix and spacing [REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, Quality Standards].
 - Iterates files from getAllFiles(codebasePath), applies replacement via a callback that increments replacementCountRef.count and returns `${p1}${newPath}`.
 - Writes file only when newContent !== content to avoid unnecessary writes and preserve formatting [REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, Quality Standards].
- src/maintenance/batch.ts:
 - batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings) loops mappings and sums updateAnnotationReferences results, performing batch updates across multiple paths [REQ-MAINT-BATCH].
 - verifyAnnotations(codebasePath) calls detectStaleAnnotations and returns true when no stale references remain [REQ-MAINT-VERIFY].
- src/maintenance/report.ts implements generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath): string.
 - Calls detectStaleAnnotations; if none, returns "" to indicate no actions needed [REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE].
 - Otherwise returns a newline-separated list of stale @story paths [REQ-MAINT-REPORT].
- src/maintenance/utils.ts (not fully shown here) provides getAllFiles(dir): string[], recursively traversing only existing directories and regular files, supporting workspace-wide operations."}, {"type":"cli-implementation","detail":"CLI and UX integration for maintenance tools:

- src/maintenance/commands.ts (not fully quoted but exercised by tests): implements handleDetect, handleVerify, handleReport, handleUpdate with clear text and JSON outputs:

traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md are satisfied with concrete, tested implementation: - Core Functionality: detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, and verifyAnnotations implement detection, update, batch, and verification, both as a programmatic API and via the traceability-maint CLI. - Quality Standards: Update operations target only @story path substrings, preserve surrounding formatting, and only write when content changes; detection and verification are read-only. - Integration: Maintenance tools are part of the plugin’s public surface (src/maintenance/index.ts, package.json bin), reuse existing story/file validation utilities, and are validated via dedicated integration and perf tests. - User Experience: CLI commands provide clear success, error, and guidance messages, support JSON/text formats, dry-run mode, and meaningful exit codes. - Error Handling: Non-existent roots, file read errors, permission errors, unsafe paths, invalid formats, and missing parameters are all handled gracefully, with safe defaults and without crashes. - Documentation: README and supporting docs describe the maintenance CLI, usage examples, and best practices. All related tests pass in the current run, confirming behavior is stable.
Therefore, the story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS is fully implemented and verified.
